svg.title: Skipper
svg.desc: The word Skipper and the line: A team of real Claude Code terminals, on one board. A route line starts at a blue dot at the lower left, runs under the words, bends up through an S and ends at a dark dot at the upper right.

g.text: A team of real Claude Code terminals, on one board.
